title: Skill recipe (schema_version 1)
description: Declarative source-of-truth for a skill the studio curates. One recipe = one upstream source pinned at a SHA + vendoring strategy + update policy. Recipes are inert data; scripts/install-recipe.sh consumes them to vendor content into <repo>/skills/vendored/.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier; matches the skill name vendored content will produce.

domain.description: Domain tags; matched against per-project .skill-domains for routing filtering.

strategy.description: Vendoring lane. `verbatim`: clone upstream as-is into skills/vendored/<author>/<skill>/, do not rewrite; SHA-bumped on update. `inspired`: rewrite in studio's Authoring Standard at skills/owned/<name>/, attribute via INSPIRED_BY.md, no automatic update. `owned`: studio-authored from scratch, no upstream tracking.

upstream.description: Upstream repo as github.com/<owner>/<repo>; only github.com is supported in v1.

path.description: Subpath within the upstream repo containing the skill content (e.g. `skills/swiftui-expert/`). Trailing slash optional.

pinned_sha.description: Upstream commit SHA the recipe is pinned to. Bumped on update.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (validated against license-allowlist.yaml at install time).

sources.description: List of upstream sources composed into this skill. Most recipes have exactly one source; multi-source recipes are reserved for inspired/owned strategies that synthesize multiple upstreams.

update_policy.description: How update-recipes.sh handles upstream SHA drift. `auto-pr`: scripted SHA bump opens a PR titled `[skills] bump <name> @ <sha-short>`; never auto-merged. `manual`: no automated update; the recipe is bumped by hand.

authoring_standard.description: Whether the vendored content must conform to _shared/standards/skill-authoring.md. `exempt` is the right setting for `verbatim` recipes (preserves the upstream author's voice); `required` for `inspired` and `owned`.

routing.description: Optional routing pre-fill. If absent, the vendored skill's own routing.yaml is the source of truth; if both exist, recipe routing wins (lets recipe author override upstream taxonomies).

attribution.description: Free-text attribution that ends up in vendor.yaml + (when applicable) INSPIRED_BY.md.

portability.description: Optional portability override. If absent, the vendored skill keeps whatever portability.yaml the upstream ships (or the studio default).
